sources.title: Fugu (model) - Learn AI
sources.snippet: Fugu is a family of orchestrator models developed by the Tokyo-based artificial intelligence research company Sakana AI. Released on June 22, 2026, Fugu represents a novel approach to achieving frontier-level performance by coordinating a pool of existing large language models rather than training a single monolithic model.

sources.title: Sakana Fugu — Multi-Agent System as a Model
sources.snippet: Sakana Fugu is a model interface for coordinating specialized AI agents through one OpenAI-compatible API.

sources.title: Sakana Fugu: Multi-Agent AI Orchestration in a Single Model
sources.snippet: Sakana Fugu is an OpenAI-compatible managed model API that looks like a single LLM but works as a multi-agent system internally. Developers send a prompt to one model ID, such as fugu or fugu-ultra, while Fugu handles agent selection, role assignment, coordination, verification, and final response.

sources.title: Sakana Fugu: A Multi-Agent Orchestration System as a Foundation Model
sources.snippet: We are excited to introduce Sakana Fugu, our flagship international commercial AI product—a multi-agent orchestration system, now opening applications for early beta testers. Sakana Fugu coordinates pools of frontier foundation models to achieve state-of-the-art performance across coding, mathematics, scientific reasoning, etc.
